executor_visible_task: A command-line script that parses a small PHP source string with a project's parser entry point aborts instead of printing a summary. Investigate the process output and exit status and determine why it aborts; do not change the input.
fix_commit_message: fix: guard inheritance traversals against cycles

fixture.input_source: classes First and Second extend each other (fixture taken from the fix commit's own regression test testClassesExtendingEachOtherAreParsedWithTheirInterfaces)
fixture.independence: repro.php is a new script, not PHPUnit; it calls the public PhpCodeParser::getPhpFiles() entry point only and is copied byte-identically into both checkouts

command: php -d memory_limit=128M -d display_errors=stderr -d log_errors=0 -d html_errors=0 -d error_reporting=-1 repro.php

environment.dependency_policy: composer update --no-dev once on the pre-fix checkout; composer.lock copied byte-identically to the fixed checkout and installed with composer install --no-dev

authoritative_validation: untouched; isolated experiment capture, not a governed validation receipt

evaluator_only.root_cause: ASTVisitor::combineImplementedInterfaces() recurses along the parentClass chain without tracking visited classes; two classes extending each other recurse until PHP exhausts memory.
evaluator_only.fix: Track visited classes in collectImplementedInterfaces()/collectParentInterfaces() and stop at cycles.
critical_markers: Allowed memory size of 134217728 bytes exhausted

expected_result: pre-fix: nonzero exit (PHP fatal, normally 255), stdout has BEGIN but not END, stderr has the memory-exhaustion fatal in ASTVisitor.php; fixed: exit 0, stdout has END and both classes with interface Cycle\Marker, stderr has no fatal

rejected_candidates.reason: The regression inputs from the fix's own test do not raise on pre-fix code under PHP 8.3 (checked locally on the pre-fix parent); the failure is PHP-version dependent and not reproducible on this runner.
Same dependency on a PHP-version-specific ValueError, no dependable trigger input in the fix commit, and the fix is a bot-authored catch-all.

limitations: A PHP memory-exhaustion fatal prints one line without a stack trace, so the diagnostic is short; this case adds a runtime fatal shape, not log volume.
The 'tried to allocate' byte count and file line depend on the PHP build and may drift.
The input is taken from the fix commit's regression test; the repro script itself was written for this experiment and was not part of the project history.
No model, token or ranking claim.
